evidence.quote: So, no, it is not time yet.
We got a really nice job report for March. It doesn’t constitute substantial further progress. It’s not close to substantial further progress.
However, these one-time increases in prices are likely to have only transitory effects on inflation.
While the recovery has progressed more quickly than generally expected, it remains uneven and far from complete.
we will continue to increase our holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month and of agency mortgage-backed securities by at least $40 billion per month
This outcome-based guidance will ensure that the stance of monetary policy remains highly accommodative as the recovery progresses.

parsed.rationale: Powell holds rates near zero and continues full asset purchases, firmly pushing back on taper talk and treating rising inflation as transitory while stressing the large employment shortfall. The only hawkish element is a conditional pledge to act if inflation became persistent, which he calls unlikely.
